Speaking with a few reporters before facing New York in Boston's home opener Friday, the center took his relocation in stride despite a sense the Knicks did not want him back. "That's what it felt like," Robinson said. Because they never made an offer? "Yeah. I was like, cool. There wasn't bad blood behind it," he said. "Fresh start."
